description: This file defines Express routes for handling service request operations in a backend API, including listing, creating, and updating service requests with authentication and role-based authorization.

methods.name: GET /
methods.description: Lists service requests based on user role; admin roles see all, customers see their own.

methods.name: POST /
methods.description: Creates a new service request, accessible to customers and super admins.

methods.name: PATCH /:id
methods.description: Updates an existing service request with specific fields; accessible to super admin and service center admin roles.
